_notes.base_url: Full public root URL, no trailing slash (include the sub-path for GitHub Pages project sites). Used for canonical tags, sitemap.xml, robots.txt and JSON-LD.
_notes.tracking_url: After joining an affiliate program, paste your full tracking link here. Every element with data-affiliate="<key>" gets this href on the next build. Leave empty to use the plain url.
_notes.contact_email: Optional. If set, it appears on the About page for corrections.
_notes.base_path: URL path the site is served under. '/curbside-rules/' for https://funnyfarm4.github.io/curbside-rules/; set to '/' for a custom domain (and change base_url to match). Every root-relative href/src is prefixed with it at build time.
